title: Graft hunter — research label
hook: Choose which monster parts to disable for safety and which to preserve for a valuable combat graft, then use the harvested ability during the hunt.
audience: Players seeking third-person melee mastery, expressive equipment, purposeful hunts and build choices.
core_loop: Explore a region, select quarry for desired rewards, fight with deliberate melee and aimed tools, make part-break tradeoffs, combine grafts, defeat a guardian and preserve recipes/access at the sanctuary.
score_notes: Provisional indirect anchors only. This is an owner-fit/mechanics inspiration pass, not a market or trend study. Fun is untested; originality is limited by comparators; exact production/animation cost and distribution response are unmeasured. Ranking in the research report is qualitative and does not select a game.

evidence.claim: Developer listing already combines third-person combat, biological weapons/mutations and persistent benefits; the broad combination is not new.

Historical official Archetypes Breakdown describes combat resources and independently progressing archetypes; inspiration for loadout identity, not a proposed content inventory. Indexed primary text was accessible when direct rendering was sparse.

risks: Highest animation/creature/camera burden of the shortlist.
Part preservation can become slow ingredient farming if it only delays health depletion.
Mutation roguelites already exist; the harvest-versus-disable decision must earn its distinction.
next_test: A representative sanctuary region with two weapon disciplines, aimed binding tool, authored part-break choices, immediately usable graft combinations, mixed threats, guardian, recipe/save and re-entry.
decision_reason: Strong alternative for visible character growth and deliberate melee; no selection or proven asset/animation pipeline.
engine_direction: Unreal5.8.2; full3D first-/third-person according to the candidate
scope_note: Substantially greater ambition; no literal10x multiplier, feature quota or hard development/owner-time cap. Counts and final campaign length are not selected.

prototype_envelope.scope: A representative sanctuary region with two weapon disciplines, aimed binding tool, authored part-break choices, immediately usable graft combinations, mixed threats, guardian, recipe/save and re-entry.

commercial_hypothesis: Unassessed in this inspiration pass; no price, sales forecast or acquisition expenditure selected.
title_note: Descriptive internal research label; naming/originality clearance not performed.

procedural_generation.direction: Designed 3D encounter modules with generated routes, compatible room configurations, encounters, objectives and rewards under playability and pacing constraints.
procedural_generation.next_test_refinement: Replay multiple generated versions of the representative biome; compare tactics, build choices, fairness and replay interest. Verify seed reproduction, save/resume, dependencies and actual in-engine traversal.
procedural_generation.evidence: Design proposal only; generator and procedural gameplay unimplemented and untested. Candidate remains draft.

decision_history.reason: Strong alternative for visible character growth and deliberate melee; no selection or proven asset/animation pipeline.
